action.description: The type of activity for the event that triggered the delivery.

delivered_at.description: Time when the delivery was delivered.

event.description: The event that triggered the delivery.

guid.description: Unique identifier for the event (shared with all deliveries for all webhooks that subscribe to this event).

installation_id.description: The id of the GitHub App installation associated with this event.

redelivery.description: Whether the delivery is a redelivery.

repository_id.description: The id of the repository associated with this event.

headers.description: The request headers sent with the webhook delivery.
The response headers received when the delivery was made.

status.description: Description of the status of the attempted delivery

status_code.description: Status code received when delivery was made.

throttled_at.description: Time when the webhook delivery was throttled.

url.description: The URL target of the delivery.
